description:
Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Inventory and configure the global inventory management settings as follows:

1. Enable stock management: Checked
2. Hold stock (minutes): 45
3. Notifications: Enable both 'Enable low stock notifications' and 'Enable out of stock notifications'
4. Notification recipient: warehouse@example.com
5. Low stock threshold: 10
6. Out of stock threshold: 2
7. Out of stock visibility: Check 'Hide out of stock items from the catalog'
8. Stock display format: Select 'Only show stock when low (e.g. "Only 2 left in stock")'

Save your changes when finished.
